whyEmptyBody: We pair you next Sunday — then there'll be something to show here.
whyIntro: The algorithm weights complementarity over similarity. These three factors scored highest in your match:

engagement_balance.title: Engagement balance
engagement_balance.body: One of you is on the rise, the other holds steady — you give each other an anchor without pushing too hard.

training_phase_offset.title: Offset training phase
training_phase_offset.body: You're not in the same program week — when @{handle} hits a heavy block, you're on deload. That creates good accountability windows.

goal_focus_alignment.title: Different goals
goal_focus_alignment.body: Cross-goal pairs (strength + hypertrophy) show higher accountability than same-goal pairs — you bring different lenses to the conversation.

hrv_pattern_complement.title: Complementary HRV pattern
hrv_pattern_complement.body: @{handle}'s readiness rhythm mirrors yours in reverse — when one swings, the other holds calm.

session_frequency_match.title: Same training cadence
session_frequency_match.body: You train at roughly the same frequency — your weeks share the same rhythm, so you don't end up with one peaking while the other rests.
